THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

1, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation, hereby declare that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of Sub section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964.

The allotment of below referred land, described in advance tracing No: KU/NRM/2022/245 and dated 07.10.2022, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at the Village of Leeniyawatta in the Grama Niladhari Division of No.1077- Ginigathpitiya in Divisional Secretary's Division of Narammala in the District of Kurunegala in the North Western Province.

01. Lot ‘A’ - Thibbatuwawewatta - Extent: About 0.2025 Hectare North by: Galwangiyawatta alias Peragasela claimed by B.A.C.J. Dharmawardhana; East by: Galwangiyawatta alias Peragasela claimed by B.A.C.J. Dharmawardhana, Palliyawatta claimed by L.M.S. Chandrasekara, Thibbatuwawewatta claimed by Narammala Pradeshiya Sabha and Thibbatuwawehena at present watta claimed by H.D.H.Perera; South by: Palliyawatta claimed by L.M.S.Chandrasekara, Thibbatuwawewatta claimed by Narammala Pradeshiya Sabha, Thibbatuwawehena at present watta claimed by H.D.H. Perera and Road (Road Development Authority); West by: Road (Road Development Authority) and Galwangiyawatta alias Peragasela claimed by B.A.C.J. Dharmawardhana.
K.D. Lal Kantha Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

1, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation hereby declare under Sub section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act that the land described below is needed for Udawalawa Lunugamwehera forest access and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The allotments of land prescribed in below mentioned names and extents, depicted in Advance Tracing No:Mo/WLL/2010/394 dated 03.09.2010 prepared by the Surveyor-General in the Village of Aliyagahakanda of Wellawaya Korale Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Wellawaya in Monaragala District of Uva Province and bounded as follows.

01. Lot ‘A’ - Kithulkoteyaya - Extent: 2.4174 Hectares North by: Land owned by the villagers; East by: Kiridioya reserve; South by: Lot B; West by: Lot B and Land owned by the villagers. 02. Lot ‘B’ - Kithulkoteyaya - Extent: 7.4189 Hectares North by: Lot A; East by: Kiridioya reserve; South by: Lot D; West by: Road (Road Development Authority).

03. Lot ‘D’ - Kithulkoteyaya - Extent: 13.5437 Hectares North by: Lot B; East by: Lot F; South by: Land belongs to Task Safari camp and Lot E; West by: Road (Road Development Authority). K.D. Lal Kantha Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation
